artworks.title: Acis and Galatea
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and traces of white heightening over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows two figures reclining closely together. The bodies are detailed, showing skin texture and muscle definition from the waist up. One figure has obscured facial features, while the other has visible delicate features and curly hair. The clothing appears minimal, resembling flowing drapery. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background consists of abstract shapes and lines, suggesting a natural environment.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape with Castles and Waterfalls
artworks.medium: black, ocher, red, and blue chalks, with traces of white heightening on gray-green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image depicts a rugged landscape with towering rock formations and a cascading waterfall. The scene is detailed with precise lines and subtle color washes in earthy tones. Small structures are visible in the distance among the rocky terrain, with sparse vegetation in the background.

artworks.title: Winter Games on the Frozen River Ijssel
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink with watercolor, gouache, and graphite on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This painting depicts a busy scene on a frozen river or lake, filled with a crowd of people. The horizon is in the center, showing boats and low buildings in the distance. Closer to us, many people are engaged in different activities on the ice. Some ride in a horse-drawn sled, while others play a game with long sticks and small round balls. The people wear colorful clothing in shades of red, blue, yellow, green, and black. Some of the women wear elaborate gowns with ruffled collars, while the men wear colorful suits and wide-brimmed hats. Other people wear simpler jackets and trousers. A few dogs run on the ice among the crowds. Aside from the colorful clothing, the color palette is mostly shades of cream, light gray, and pale blue.

artworks.title: Interior of Saint Bavo's Church, Haarlem
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and touches of red chalk over graphite on laid paper, squared in red chalk; laid down
artworks.creditLine: The Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner

artworks.title: The Parable of the Publican and the Pharisee
artworks.medium: reed pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner

artworks.title: Culemborg Castle
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a large circular castle-like building on the right side, with a low horizon on the center-right meeting a reflective water surface. The brushstrokes are subtle and delicate, emphasizing details and smooth transitions between shades. The color palette consists of gray and sepia tones. The water reflects the structures, creating depth. In the distance to the left, additional buildings with pointed roofs and smaller towers are visible.

artworks.title: Seven Famous Figures from Ancient History
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor, heightened with white, on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner

artworks.title: Portrait of a Noblewoman (Madame de Pellegars?)
artworks.medium: black and red chalks with stumping, heightened with white chalk, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows an unfinished portrait of a person's face and upper torso. The person is facing the viewer with their head slightly turned to the left. They have fair skin, light-colored eyes, eyebrows, and narrow lips. Their hair is styled back, and they are wearing a large ruff around their neck. The clothing details around the ruff are suggested in light pencil. The person is wearing a pearl earring in their right ear. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Cupid Stealing Venus's Floral Crown
artworks.medium: orange-red, white, and black chalk, squared for transfer in black chalk, on blue laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person in a relaxed seated pose with their back slightly inclined and head tilted to the right. The person has closed eyes, a serene expression, and styled hair in an updo. They are draped in cloth, with a smaller figure depicted to the upper right holding a wreath or garland over the main figure's head. The background is a neutral tone.

artworks.title: A Performance by the Commedia dell'Arte
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an architectural setting. The scene depicts several animated figures against classical architectural elements such as columns and arches. The figures are rendered in a loose, expressive line, capturing motion and emotion in their gestures. The drawing has a sketched quality and employs ink with varying thickness and washes to suggest depth and texture. The emphasis on movement and interaction, combined with the architectural setting, suggests a lively and dynamic moment frozen in time.

artworks.title: Studies of Ornament and Architecture
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image displays a series of intricate, swirling lines and shapes that form an abstract composition. The arrangement of the lines and curves resemble ornate architectural details or decorative elements. The drawing invites the viewer to connect these forms to familiar objects like decorative scrollwork or vintage calligraphy. The overall appearance of the piece is reminiscent of a detailed sketch focused on exploring patterns and textures.

artworks.title: The Archery Contest
artworks.medium: black and white chalks on light brown laid paper (formerly blue)
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubs engaged in playful activities on a cloud. The artwork depicts several cherubs lounging and interacting with one another amidst ethereal clouds. Some cherubs hold arrows, and others appear to be engaged in a lively, celebratory mood. The drawing is executed with delicate pencil strokes and highlighted areas, imbuing the scene with a sense of lightness and movement. The paper has a warm, sepia tone that complements the soft shading. The scene blends aspects of classical and Rococo styles, characterized by the cherubs’ rounded forms and a sense of playful innocence. The composition is framed within an arched border.

artworks.title: Bust of an Old Man
artworks.medium: red, black, and white chalks with stumping and erasure on light brown laid paper, with later framing line in dark brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of an older man, focusing on his head and upper torso. He is depicted lying back, with his head tilted slightly upward and to his right. His facial features are prominent, showcasing deep-set eyes, a long nose, and a slightly open mouth with visible lines around it. The man has long, wavy, gray hair that cascades down around his shoulders. He is wearing a light-colored scarf loosely tied around his neck, complementing his neutral-toned shirt. The background is a subdued, monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: Pittacus the Tyrant in War Costume
artworks.medium: graphite with watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body drawing of a person in an intricate costume. The individual stands upright, with one hand resting on their hip and the other holding a staff. The person's face has a long beard and is framed by an ornate helmet decorated with feathers, adorned with blue and gold accents. The rest of the costume is detailed, featuring armor-like segments and embellishments in gold, with touches of blue. A lion-faced breastplate stands out among the chest adornments, and similar decoration appears on the legs with armor protecting the knees and shins. The background is plain, consisting of a parchment-like texture without any distinct features.

artworks.title: Oriental Horsewoman in a Desolate Mountain Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This artwork depicts a scene from an elevated perspective, showcasing a landscape with rocky formations dominating the right side. The rocks are detailed with fine brushstrokes suggesting a rugged texture. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and hints of sepia. In the foreground, a figure on horseback is dressed elaborately, with flowing garments and an extravagant hat. Behind the figure, a group of people can be seen in the distance. Above, a flock of birds flies across the textured sky.

artworks.title: Oriental Horseman in a Desolate Mountain Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image depicts a knight on horseback as the main focus, positioned off-center to the right. A second figure, also on horseback, is partially obscured by rocky terrain in the background. The horizon is not visible, as craggy rocks dominate the scene. The sky is cloudy with subtle variations. The style features detailed lines and shading, creating an almost engraving-like appearance. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. The contrast between the figures and the rocky terrain highlights the subjects against the backdrop.

artworks.title: Six Conversing Men and Ten Battling Nudes
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink on blue-gray prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two scenes. The upper scene shows robed figures conversing, while the lower scene depicts nude figures in interaction. The drawing features fine lines capturing the figures with a classical style. The top section illustrates draped figures facing each other, gesturing. The bottom part shows unclothed figures with muscular detail, some holding weapons or shields. The linework focuses on human anatomy and clothing folds against a light-colored background.

artworks.title: Standing Youth
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with traces of charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile standing upright with one hand on the hip. The individual has an angular face, curly hair pulled back under a tall hat, and is wearing a tunic with decorative details on the sleeves and hem, paired with leggings or bare legs. The background is an aged, textured paper.

artworks.title: A Hound Chasing a Hare
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with traces of red chalk, heightened with white on pink prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a hunting scene featuring a dog chasing a hare.

artworks.title: Three Philosophers
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three men depicted from the waist up, seated around a table. The central figure is slightly turned to the right, looking towards the man on the right. He has a beard and is wearing a turban-like headpiece. The man on the left has a full beard and is wearing a cap and robe, leaning slightly forward. On the right, the man with curly hair and a long beard is wearing a pointed hat and appears to be resting his head on his hand. There are a few bound volumes on the table in front of them. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures. The paper is light brown and plain.

artworks.title: A Complex of Rustic Houses Built Over Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper; laid on mid-eighteenth century Italian paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The drawing shows a rustic structure surrounded by trees. The scene is viewed from an elevated perspective. The focus is on detailed buildings with pointed roofs and intricate architectural elements, depicted using sketch-like brushstrokes and hatching. The image is in sepia tones, creating a vintage feel. Depth is created through layering elements and suggesting trees on either side, drawing the viewer towards the center of the buildings.

artworks.title: A Village Nestled at the Foot of a Hill (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with buildings, hills, and distant mountains or hills. The viewpoint seems slightly elevated, indicating a perspective looking from a small hill or distance. The drawing showcases detailed structures like houses and medieval-style buildings against rocky terrain. The landscape expands into rolling hills and peaks on the right, with fine lines and cross-hatching used for texture and depth. The color scheme is monochrome, mainly brown and sepia. The foreground contains rocky outcrops, trees, hills, and foliage, creating depth and continuity in the scenery.

artworks.title: Head of a Boy (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract forms resembling dynamic sketches of anatomical studies, primarily focusing on muscular forms. The drawing showcases several roughly sketched forms that appear to represent contorted muscular structures. The forms are rendered in a loose style with pronounced lines creating a sense of motion and tension. The paper has a textured appearance, enhancing the rawness of the sketches. The composition is informal, suggesting an exploratory study.

artworks.title: Figures and Legs (verso)
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of anatomical studies featuring muscular forms. The image contains sketches of limbs and torsos in different poses, capturing the details and contours of human musculature. The lines are confident and expressive, hinting at a study of human anatomy. Each form is depicted in different states of motion, showing an understanding of static and dynamic positions.
